gen-dafont-origami-gf-michroma: Neon-tube glow from Origami, one steady line throughout, while Michroma gives every letter a wide berth on both sides. Origami dazzles at the top; Michroma spaces itself out below.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-mozilla-text: Unique brush-painted letters in Origami hold one thickness all the way through, while Mozilla Text flares its terminals outward. Origami makes the loud statement; the plain sans carries the sentences.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-nobile: Nobile keeps its capitals barely above the lowercase and leaves its letter mouths open, sitting under Origami's single-stroke brush heading. Paragraphs of it would move along smoothly, without any hurry.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Modern in mood, Origami's measured strokes sit over Noto Kufi Arabic. What stands out is the sameness of Origami's line against the body's welcoming gap in the c, with capitals sitting just above lowercase.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans: Marker-drawn and steady, that's Origami at the top. Noto Sans sits beneath it with lowercase bodies filling most of the letter height and a generously open c, so heading and text feel like different voices.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam keeps its curve endings well apart. Over a full page its tall, full c, s and z give text a generous, open rhythm, a quiet foil to Origami's marker-traced heading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-bengali: Contemporary all the way: Origami's joins hold the line's weight, while Noto Sans Bengali keeps capitals barely taller than lowercase. Origami shouts once; the open-mouthed sans lets text follow.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-brahmi: Noto Sans Brahmi reads high-set and open-ended on every curve, quite unlike Origami's uniformly weighted bowls and stems. Extended paragraphs would move along lightly, with nothing crowding the curves.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-buginese: Brush-drawn and measured: Origami ends every stroke at one thickness, while Noto Sans Buginese leaves its letter mouths open. Short ascenders keep the text low under Origami's heading.
gen-dafont-origami-gf-noto-sans-cherokee: Origami draws its letters like spaghetti laid out, one steady line, over Noto Sans Cherokee's tall band of letters. And the plain sans, with short stalks above and a wide gap in its e, keeps the page grounded.
